summary: In general, LLM performance is incredibly multidimensional. There's no guarantee of a fixed ordering where the model that is best at math is also the model that's best at jokes.
takeaways: Despite that complexity, much of the variation in performance is explained by just a single variable: model size.
There's no guarantee of a fixed ordering where the model that is best at math is also the model that's best at jokes.
